It converts latitude and longitude to a point on the sphere of radius `camera.planetRadius`, using north = +Z and east = -Y at longitude 0 (from note 16), so a heading of 90° looks toward increasing longitude. It assigns a new `Vector3` to `camera.center` because note 10 says in-place writes don't re-orbit the eye, and it leaves yaw, pitch and radius alone.
